calls `00576030` on a stack buffer; with P the qword three loads deep from `rcx+0x60` (qword `rcx+0x60`, then qword `+0` twice; a null `rcx` leaves the middle value 0, so the last load reads address 0) and B the qword at qword `+0x60` of qword `+0xC0` of qword `rcx+0xE0` (0 when either of the last two is null), it writes to `rdx`: word `+0` = word `P+4`, word `+2` = word `P+6`, word `+4` = word `B+0x10` (100 when B is 0), byte `+6` = word `P+0xA` divided (unsigned) by word `+0xA` of the 20-byte entry indexed by word `P+0xC` in `0020E600(dword +0x20 of qword rcx+0xE8)`, and byte `+7` = byte `P+8` minus the low byte of word `+4`

with G the qword at `02CA9738`, R its qword `+0x108` and D the qword `R+0xF0`, returns 0 unless G is non-null, byte `R+0xC9` is 1 (read before R is tested, so a null R faults rather than returning 0), R and D are non-null and `ecx` lies in 0 to word `D+0xE` minus 1 (signed); otherwise returns the word at `+4` of record `ecx` (12-byte stride) whose table starts at the 32-bit sum of word `D+0xA` and the low half of D, or 0 when that address is zero
